info.title: ReHealth tenant administration API
info.description: Read-only tenant-scoped patient aggregation for the website administration console.

get.description: Requires rehealth:admin:patient:view. Returns only active members of the authenticated operator's validated tenant. Because profile and risk tables have no tenant column, users with another active tenant membership are excluded fail-closed. The list never calls Device Service, so every row has provenanceStatus=unknown; consumers MUST NOT include unknown rows in clinical risk statistics.

200.description: RehealthPatientPageVO in the standard Jeecg Result envelope

get.description: Requires rehealth:admin:patient:view. Verifies exclusive active target membership before one tenant-scoped Device Service read. Synthetic, mock, demo, sample, LOCAL_TEST_SEED, or ring_sim provenance sets isSynthetic=true and suppresses latestRisk in this response.

200.description: RehealthUserHealthVO in the standard Jeecg Result envelope

404.description: Patient is not an exclusive active member of the selected tenant

503.description: Software database, Device Service, or mounted internal credential unavailable

get.description: Disabled legacy route. Requires the same patient-view permission and returns code 410 without user data.

PatientSummary.description: PII-minimized patient view; phone, email and account username are never returned.

provenanceStatus.description: List rows are unknown and must not be counted as clinical risk. Detail rows are authoritative from Device Service.
